blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte took the witness stand on Tuesday in the impeachment trial of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte. The House prosecution panel presented Baste Duterte to testify on the Davao City government’s transactions with GenCorp Industries Inc., a company allegedly linked to the vice president’s business interests.
